newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Bridgestone buys TSR20 in Singapore rubber.
newsitem.headline: Bridgestone buys TSR20 in Singapore rubber.

text.p: Bridgestone engaged in a bout of buying for TSR20 grade rubber on Wednesday in the Singapore rubber market while other players were said to be involved in some covering for RSS1 rubber, dealers said.
"Bridgestone picked up some forward shipments of TSR20 rubber. I think there was also some covering for RSS1 rubber," a trader said.

The price paid by Bridgestone for the TSR20 it bought was not immediately available but was said to range between 109.00 to 111.00 U.S. cents a kg. The bulk of the buying was said to be concentrated in the November/February period, dealers said.

Consumers may engage in further shortcovering over the next few days, traders said. Dealings in the market remained a bit thin with the lower close in Tokyo keeping some players sidelined, traders said.
"Volumes were not that heavy and were in fact quite modest. It was routine stuff," one dealer said.

At 0945 GMT, July RSS3 was indicated at 114.50 U.S. cents a kg from 115.00 cents. July RSS1 was seen at 163.75 Singapore cents (US$1.14) a kg from 164.25 cents. October/December TSR20 was seen steady at 110.25 U.S. cents a kg.
